text:
maria.p: Quick GA heads-up — SlimStream is now GA on Hosted. Lightweight streaming endpoint designed for low-bandwidth and mobile clients. Docs and migration guide: https://internal.redwood.company/docs/slimstream (internal). :tada:

alex.s: Nice! Is this a new service or a mode on existing streaming?

maria.p: It's a new streaming mode served by the same gateway. You enable it with stream_mode=\"slim\" (or use the SDK flag). Backwards-compatible with streaming-v1 payloads, but SlimStream emits smaller incremental chunks and a compact control frame.

jordan.k: SDK impact? Will we need a major bump?

maria.p: Minor bump — client SDK 2.4.0 includes SlimStream client helpers and automatic reassembly for intermittent networks. CDN-friendly chunking added. Release notes linked in the doc.

priya.r: Ops notes: default per-connection token window is 4k, soft throttles apply at 120 rps per-tenant to prevent burst storms. If you need guaranteed throughput, request Dedicated capacity or set reserved_concurrency in your project. Fallback policy: when slim capacity is constrained we auto-route to standard streaming (may increase payload size).

alex.s: Migration snippet for backend teams: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"mosaic-slim\",\"stream_mode\":\"slim\",\"input\":\"summarize...\"}'
```

maria.p: Note: if you rely on chunk-level function-calls, test carefully — SlimStream batches small tool-call frames more aggressively. We have guidance in the function-calls section of the guide.

jordan.k: Will there be cost differences?

maria.p: SlimStream typically reduces per-token egress by ~20–35% for low-latency mobile workloads due to smaller headers and reduced heartbeat traffic. Billing is still token-based; you'll see unit-cost improvements in the cost breakdown dashboard once traffic hits SlimStream.

priya.r: Monitoring checklist for oncall: add parser for slim chunk control frame in tracer, watch `slim.stream.latency_p50` and `slim.stream.chunk_retries`. Runbook updated: https://internal.redwood.company/runbooks/slimstream-oncall

deploy-bot: release/slimstream-gw succeeded — canary at 100% in us-west-2 (build 2026.04.12.331).

maria.p: We're doing an internal demo + Q&A Friday 09:30 PT (calendar invite sent). If you manage integrations, please smoke test against the slim sandbox: https://sandbox.redwood.ai/slim. Post any migration blockers in #devex and tag me.

alex.s: Great — will run tests this afternoon. :rocket:

jordan.k: Thx! I'll add a changelog entry for SDK.

maria.p: Thanks team — big win for mobile latency-sensitive apps. :heart:
